{"answer":"No, the lottery in Plato’s Myth of Er is not the same as the astrological Lot of Spirit. In the Myth of Er, drawn lots are a symbolic method to determine the order of lives chosen after death, serving a narrative and philosophical purpose. The astrological Lot of Spirit is a specific angular calculation involving the Ascendant, Sun, and Moon, based on a named conventional formula used in astrology. These are distinct concepts: one is a mythological device, the other a technical astrological computation. Plato does not provide the astrological formula in the referenced passage [EVAL-D09-S1].","citations":["EVAL-D09-S1"],"actions":[]}
